QuestInfo.name: Make a Match Cards Set
QuestInfo.parent: Maple World's Unique Fun: Match Cards
QuestInfo.0: It seems that #p228# in #m010001050# knows a way to have a different kind of fun in Maple World.
QuestInfo.1: I met #b#p228##k in #m010001050#. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting if I brought him enough #t4031045#s. Getting them should be easy. I just have to defeat any of the following monsters, scattered across Maple World: #b#o3##k, #b#o8##k, #b#o10##k, #b#o12##k, #b#o16##k, #b#o19##k, #b#o23##k, #b#o31##k, #b#o35##k, #b#o37##k, #b#o36##k, #b#o41##k, #b#o43##k, #b#o45##k, or #b#o51##k. I should try to gather them when I have time.
QuestInfo.2: I brought the requested items to #p228# in #m010001050# and received a #b#t4080100##k! With this, I can play the Match Cards mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask #p228# if I want to know more about the mini-game.

0.0: Hey, you! You look like you're worn out from all that hunting. My creed is to live a life of enjoyment! How about it? If you bring me just a few items, I'll exchange them for a mini-game item. What do you say?

yes.0: Good! But you can't just play a mini-game right away. If you want to play the Match Cards mini-game, you'll need a #b#t4080100##k.
yes.1: To make a #t4080100#, I need #b#t4031045#s#k. You can get #t4031045#s by taking down monsters scattered across this island, so please bring me 15 of them. I'll be waiting for you right here.

no.0: Hey, sometimes you just need to take a break and look around! If you change your mind, talk to me anytime.

1.0: Say! These are definitely 15 #b#t4031045#s#k. That couldn't have been easy--you're amazing! All right! Time for me to show off my skills! Just wait a moment. I'll craft your #b#t4080100##k in no time. Heave-ho!

yes.0: You got your #b#t4080100##k, right? You can use this item anywhere in Maple World to open a mini-game room and have fun with others. If you achieve a high score, something great is sure to happen. I'll be cheering you on from here, so give it your best shot!
yes.1: Oh, right. If you ever have any questions about Match Cards, just ask me anytime. I plan on staying here for a while. Now then, go on and try hard to become the ultimate mini-game champion, surpassing even me! Though... That's probably not going to happen. Anyway... I'm busy, so I'll see you later.

item.0: To make #t4080100#, I need #b#t4031045#s#k. You can get #t4031045#s by taking down monsters scattered across this island, so please bring me 15 of them. I'll be waiting for you right here.
